instruction: merge_query() in query.py builds the new query string by hand-joining "key=value" pairs, so special characters in a parameter value (spaces, &, =, #) are never percent-encoded and corrupt the resulting URL. Fix merge_query() to produce a properly percent-encoded query string (the standard library's urlencode is the right tool) without changing its signature or breaking the existing tests in tests/test_query.py.
